sphere_commentary.overview:
Across 30 protocols the aggregate mean sits near the intended 7-point target, with series-specific patterns aligning to design intent.
• HEALING (n=574) achieves the highest consistency (std 1.77) with mean 6.98, led by Over-stimulation and Sleep clusters.
• THRIVING (n=245) shows peak efficacy in Focus & Clarity, with T-FC-L3 at 7.63 mean — the highest observed score.
• TRANSFORMING (n=181) displays the widest spread (std 1.87) and lowest mean (6.59), consistent with its ascending-arc design targeting low-affect states.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
The three series show distinct efficacy profiles that reflect their design intent.
• HEALING leads in listener consistency, with the lowest variance across entry points and strong outcomes in DESCENT protocols.
• THRIVING shows the highest mean scores, particularly in Focus & Clarity protocols where HOLD design appears to support sustained entrainment.
• TRANSFORMING carries the most spread — expected given its ascending-arc design — with notable population split signals in several protocols.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols exhibit unusually high variance or mismatched signals warranting investigation.
• X-MC-L3 (n=10) mean 5.70, std 2.45 — lowest observed score with extreme spread, flagged by multiple analyzers as likely population mismatch.
• X-MD-L3 (n=13) mean 7.15, std 2.38 — wide spread despite respectable mean, with highest cross-run drift (sim=0.507) indicating analytical instability.
• H-OS-L3 shows drift into sleep protocol semantic space despite over-stimulation designator — potential functional reclassification warranted.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted protocol refinements can improve efficacy across the library.
• H-OS-L1 (n=95) — strong mean 7.15, highest YouTube views (30), AutoGluon routes X-ME protocols here — expand Adviser routing to capitalize on reach.
• T-FC-L3 (n=35) — highest observed mean (7.63), AutoGluon predicts 7.728 — elevated routing and replication priority.
• X-MC-L3 (n=10) — low mean, high std, 4/17 report rhythm too busy — consider hold phase extension or adviser deactivation.
• X-ME-L1 (n=39) — predicted score 8.230 highest in AutoGluon, cross-bucket routed to crisis/sleep/focus — expand routing despite ASCENT design.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Cross-run drift is pronounced for many protocols, while semantic clustering validates several design families.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: Notable drift (sim<0.85) detected in 28/30 protocols — highest in X-MD-L3 (0.507), H-SL-L1 (0.530), T-FC-L3 (0.532) indicates evolving analytical interpretation.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Strong similarity between T-FC-L1↔L2 (0.878), H-SL-L1↔L2 (0.869), T-CF-L1↔L2 (0.841) validates design families; H-OS-L3 most analytically distinct (mean_sim=0.677).
• Confidence note: Drift analysis based on 26 runs — stable for strong-signal protocols but shows high variance in TRANSFORMING series.

by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L3: The standout performer — most people feel significantly better after listening.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L1: Good outcome but many need around twenty minutes to settle.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L2: Mixed results with some finding the rhythm too active.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L3: Works for some, but a few don't settle at all — lower confidence due to few listeners.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L1: Noticeable improvement for most, though a couple felt worse.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L2: Strong improvement for many, with the highest reach in this cluster.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L3: Lowest performer — many find the rhythm too busy and outcomes are mixed.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L1: Fast settle but only about half feel better — high variance in responses.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L2: Slower to work, with only a few feeling better.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L3: Outperforms peers despite very few listeners, but responses vary widely.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L1: Many feel better but take longer to settle; predicted to be very effective.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L2: Similar to L1 with slightly more positive responses.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L3: Lowest in the mood and energy group with some reporting no effect.
